name: Birth Of Christ
overview: The birth of Christ is a divine fulfillment of Old Testament prophecy, where a virgin conceives and bears a son named Immanuel, meaning 'God with us' (Isaiah 7:14; Matthew 1:23). This child, born in Bethlehem as foretold by Micah, is given names that reveal His nature and mission: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace (Isaiah 9:6; Micah 5:2). The Gospel of Matthew emphasizes that Jesus' birth was by the Holy Spirit, and His name signifies salvation, as He will save His people from their sins (Matthew 1:18, 21). Together, these verses affirm the miraculous and redemptive purpose of Christ’s birth as the foundation of our faith.
